root_cause: Every existing route-tree node was inserted as a zero-cost multi-source seed. Search criticality therefore charged only the new branch and ignored source-to-attachment upstream tree delay, strongly favoring deep attachment on high-fanout nets.
implemented_screen: Optional route-tree timing seeds initialize each attachment with its source-to-node accumulated local RR delay weighted by the connection criticality.
claim_boundary: The diagnosis uses the existing final per-connection VPR/Tatum export. The replacement policy requires separate legality and native-QoR validation.
